note: Filtered sample: all 1,451 written reviews the Play Store's own review data returned (newest first) were read in the built-in browser; 577 contain a family or caregiving word; the 66 of those that also mention inviting, adding, sharing, connecting, access, log-in, sign-in, accounts, permissions, passwords or joining are saved here (for the 'relatives join with their own access' column). Reviewer names omitted. Not a random sample.

reviews.text: repeatedly having to reinstall due to Log in has expired messages and its days before requests for assistance are addressed. I'm trying to keep track of my mother. MORE HEADACHE than anything.

Horrible customer service. It's been over a month and my app won't connect. I keep getting "server error." I have made several calls; the reps promise they'll get back to me... crickets. The last call I made, the rep told me the tracking feature is only a "feature" and they don't guarantee it will work. I waited on hold over 15 minutes to speak to a supervisor; I finally gave up. Currently shopping for other tracking devices for my Mom.
This app is garbage. The invitation was sent but I can't login to the app. Now the app won't even open. How am I supposed to keep up with my mom with this app? Ridiculous.
Can't manage settings on the app, it crashes whenever you try to add a phone number or edit the name. It also failed to detect a fall when my Dad fell in the yard, didn't work at all.
I downloaded the app to monitor my mom. It keeps crashing while I'm trying to add her number. In fact, anything I try to do in managing settings closes the app.

I'm the payer of my mother's account, however at last update it changed her name to mine. It gives incorrect information where she is located & map will NOT update, always says error. I purchased this for her protection and it has failed greatly. Time to find new product

Very basic app. Unimpressive battery life. An update needs to be made to the battery info visible in the caregiver app. It says battery normal until it is so low that it sends an alert. My loved one panics when the battery alerts her it is too low so I have to drive over, no matter the time to help. PLEASE add a battery percentage display so I don't have to guess what her battery level is.

I have uninstalled, reinstalled, read, changed, researched. Claims to be connected to moms phone, but I cannot get any activity reports. This whole process, from activating phone to this app, has been distressing. It would be a nightmare if my mom had tried to handle this. Not intuitive or user friendly at all, plagued with developer issues.
I cant even invite my wife...it says click "manage invites" in upper rightcorner....there is no "manage invites" there!!

When first installed, the app worked perfectly. We lost connection with the device last week, customer service walked us through a reset of all devices(2 caregiver phones and the wearable device)which took over 4 hrs. Now the app connects but we don't get notifications, there's no log of activity, and we have to "reset location" to get a status report. NOT WHAT WE EXPECTED WHEN WE PAID FOR THIS DEVICE! FIX THIS!
wont install...update...got it installed but I dont stay logged in, I have to sign in to view map and I am not getting notifications when my Mom is out and about which makes this app useless.

Poor - misleading website & claims. Bought mom the Jitterbug Smart 2 "smartphone." Battery life is beyond poor. App is unreliable on my end -location sharing NEVER updates. To this day, it still shows mom at a location from 3 months ago, even lists date as September xx, 2020. Tried reinstalling app and refreshing to no avail. Good luck with any "customer service." Don't waste your money here.

App is totally unreliable. Could not provide map information on 4 of 5 trips in 1 month. Shows battery as charging when not plugged in. CS blamed the flip phone. Accepted discount on new Smartphone. Location was accurate after 25 minutes of search time but the phone status still indicates phone is charging and it is not plugged in. Per CS, I forced an update on both phones on 9/28 with no change. CS requested a forced update on both phones on 9/29 along with a restart of the app. Completed both. Requested "refresh data" through the app at 8:10 AM and the phone is still reporting the inaccurate information from the previous evening time stamped 7:49PM and it is now 8:44 AM. Another issue, phone states my husband is "out and about" when he is at our home address; which is extremely frustrating. With the COVID virus I am more aware of my husband's activities. When I am traveling for work this app is of no help. Due to medical concerns it is critical that accurate information is available when requested. If you need this information in a hurry this is not the app to use. If this is in any way connected to the 5star system it raises serious questions in my mind about the reliability of that as well.

Worthless. Will not show/update location of my Mom's device. Constantly says to "Check Device" on home screen. Have verified device is charged and functioning normally. Have verified I am linked to the account. Defeats the whole purpose and reason I chose this product for my Mom. I do not recommend.
Since thee latest update, every time I log into the app to check on my loved one, I have to log in with my email address and password. That wasn't an issue before

App still will not allow me to login. I can login to My Link on my computer, but the same username and password doesn't work with the app. Still a one star rating. Had to download the app twice this week because it was not working properly. the app still crashes often and the push notifications don't work. now down to one star. the header says Mom is at home, but the map clearly shows that she is not at home. i get frequent reports that the app has crashed.
Bring back the old app, I have had nothing but issues with this new app. I have to sign in each time, it is not tracking my 85 yr old Father. This app is horrible.

Update 12/13/19: New app won't keep me signed in. I have to login in every time I get an alert. Why? It could waste precious minutes in the event of an emergency. Please fix. Before their last update, I got notified any time my elderly mother was away from home for more than 20 minutes. Now I get nothing and all the company does with these ratings is give the same answer. Call or email them with your problem and they will "look into it". Great Call, you need to "look" harder.

I've used this app to keep tabs on my 95 parent. I updated the app because it was constantly crashing on my phone. Now it will not allow me to log in. I get a message that the server is down. I have no way of connecting to the app nor knowing if my parent is using his device! Help!

I've never had so many problems with an app and cellular service provider in my life! This has got to thee worst worst worst product!! Please do not waste your time and money!! This is bad. I cant track my mom The app never works. Today when I uninstalled and reinstalled the app for the 10th time, I am now connected to a strangers phone! Map and all! How do you like that?? I can track an unknown woman. Not only does this not work but it works to invade the privacy of others!! Reporting Now!!

Not reliable! GPS is inaccurate, syncing issues every time I try to use the app...and now the app is not working at all! It takes me to the sign-in screen, I enter the log in info and then it tells me network is unavailable. Worthless if I can't check on my mom! Update 11-18-19: still unreliable as ever... it's been 10 days since an accurate check in for my mom's device.

Nothing but trouble and constant crashes with this app for 2 YEARS, the service required by my elderly mothers care provider. Meanwhile they continue to suck a monthly payment from her account. Worthless!

in the past 6 months, this link unsync's on it's own which jeopardizes my connection to my 92 year old mother. I have called there customer services numerous times since June to fix this issue without success. I'm extremely frustrated & will begin looking for other service companies.

Totally useless. While using my phone I constantly get notifications popping up saying the app needs to shut down. The only way I could get rid of it was to open the app. Now when I open the app it asks for my password but as soon as it gets to the main screen it bounces me back to the login page. Hopefully nothing happens to my mother because I won't have any idea until well after the fact. Need to switch to Life Alert.

This worked great for the first few days. Now I can't get in it at all. I'm getting "attempt to log in failed due to server error. Please try again later. " I use this to watch my dad. How do I know it's working if I can't even get in the app? zero stars 😡

my husband fell yesterday and I could not get to the button because he had fallen in front of our stairs.I tried using my cell phone that has the great call site I'd down loaded the site from google access to official site. the monitor worked for a few days. my daughter also is linked too. my smart phone frozed multiple times. greatcall wouldn't open to get assistance to help my husband up off the floor. Does anyone monitor users complaints or comments. my husband is new with an alert system.

Android version .. weekly review doesn't come all the time or on time; received a push notification Mom used device and 5star was contacting her but I only saw it when I happened to look at my phone and there was no info from the followup shared. The app has limited settings and doesn't always connect in a timely manner even though I have service.

The app is not connect in the past week, it turns off quickly i am not able to read why...it flashes its message and closes before I can react or read it. What is happening? I have loved this for my aging mother...now I have doubts.

Can't even get it to login. I emailed support and they said it's a known issue and they are working on it, but no timeline for a fix. Bought the service for my father, in part, because they had this app. Very disappointed as I have to login to the website which isn't convenient and I can't get notifications which is critical.

This app stopped working for me about a month ago -- basically I could no longer log in, could not change my password, and stopped receiving email status updates about my parent.  After two phone calls, the person in the support center had me update the app (which wanted permission to my contacts, photos, files, etc - which seemed highly inappropriate). After more conversation, she asks if I"m on a Pixel phone and then, "oh there's a problem, it won't work with that phone."  I have never had such a poor experience with an app before.

App won't let me login. I know I have the right information because I can 
sign in online. Very frustrating that I can't check on my grandma

Can not get a network connection for the app. It's been going on to long. 9 
out of 10 no network connection. Need to find something different for my 
mom.

Was working well. All of the sudden it won't. It keeps saying no internet 
connection available when there clearly is one. Very disappointed that I 
can't be notified about my mom in case of emergency..

I can no longer access the app so I can't monitor my family member It keeps 
telling me can't refresh because network is unavailable. I have no issues 
with other apps

Wonderful concept but it doesn't work! The app never reflects current, 
accurate information. One day it showed that my Aunt was in Carlsbad CA. 
Not only has she never been there, but she was in her home in OK when I 
received that notification! Ironically, the weekly report said that she had 
not traveled outside of her usual areas. Conflicting info, wouldn't you 
say? We have the push notifications enabled, but we're not receiving them. 
I guess that's just as well, because them the information us rarely 
correct. Even the battery & power info is inaccurate. For instance, it will 
show that the unit is charging, when she has it around her neck. The 
location takes forever to update & if/when it finally does, it's wrong, 
too. Update: I guess now I don't have to worry about the erroneous 
information in the app, because like many others, it will no longer allow 
me to sign in! I've uninstalled/reinstalled the app numerous times, 
restarted my phone & called for technical assistance. I still cannot sign 
in!! After a few calls to Great Call, a tech finally told me that they were 
aware of the problems with the app & they are working on it. She also told 
me I could call back in 90 days to check the status of the repairs. 90 
days? Seriously?! In 90 days, it will no longer be my problem, because I'm 
going shopping for a different company ASAP! I bought this for peace of 
mind since I live 2 hours away from my Aunt, but between the unit's battery 
dying in less than 10 hours & this useless app, I've bought a headache 
rather than peace of mind!

My mother is 89 , with a detected fall or push of a button , with her fall 
alert she has instant access to professional emergency personnel who can 
dispatch multiple emergency services instantaneously , connect her with 
family in emergencies with cell phones and will engage a 3 way conversation 
until you get to your loved ones home ,they keep you connected until your 
emergency is over , no extra charges so far, she can use it to get any 
information , help , directions , with GPS locating, I can locate her on my 
cell phones maps app within 30 to 50 feet , great for when we get separated 
shopping at malls and need to find her , anywhere cell phones work, I think 
Verizon is their Network provider, they have never failed my so far, for 
less than a Dollar a day you can be with your loved one from a distance and 
they have instant access to you within seconds , your loved ones have 5 
seconds to reset the device if triggered accidentally and if your to slow 
to reset the device they ask you the nature of your call and proceed 
appropriately , this is the best service you can get that I know of for 
your money 💰. I love it , Bob Morton , Santa Rosa , CA. For users that 
have problems : It always starts with sync errors on my phone ,so I would 
ignore it , it doesn't seem to effect the app , I go to the Greatcall map 
and update location, if you know they are in transit you must update 
location for immediate locating , it could take 5 minutes or longer, try 
updating ever 5 minutes if it doesn't relocate your loved one , the worst 
locating I experienced was off 300 feet , normally is fairly accurate 
within 50 feet , that's really cool. If She's missed a ride , I can update 
her location and know if she is stuck somewhere and go get her. 10 🌟 
rating with me !!!!

Great call showed my Mom's battery being fully discharged and the power off. My Mom said she'd had it on the charger overnight. This has happened frequently. Also, I'm unable to access and review her activity other than in the present time. No greater detail is available. I was told I hadn't created an account yet it pops up as created but i cant access detail.

The link app needs permission for administrator  to be able to reboot phone. I bought for my soon to be 91 yr. old father, who is electronics device illiterate. "Cannot locate", I've seen more times than not. The android link app, constantly has to be restarted,  due to "stopped responding",  on an S7, Verizon all updated. ALSO, he has NO email. I had to setup an email for his admin acct, and invite myself?  That's messed up. It's not cheap, I hope 5 star emergency works if ever needed. Yes, I tested it. Thanks

My phone updated and somehow I was logged out of the app. The only way to log back in is w an email and password. I have tried every email I have and my mom has to log back in and to no avail. I have requested PW reset for each email tried and nothing. I have uninstalled the app and reinstalled numerous times. I'm at my wits end. I haven't been able to link to my mom's device in almost two months now. Please advise a solution

Every time I sign in my father's phone information comes up for one second then the app kicks me off and I have to re-sign in can you please fix this my father lives in a travel trailer and is traveling the country I need this to work it's been like this for approximately two weeks please contact me.... This old man has been missing for 3 weeks your customer service agents refuse to be able to find his location and even though I have been added to his account 3 times they refuse to talk to me!!!!     If I get a call from a sheriff I hope you have very good liability insurance
Works well with my Dad's Jitterbug phone, but he has a Lively product as well. Can the application accomodate two devices under the same account?

Since we switched to the "Lively" device three weeks ago. Since getting new device I have received no notifications that my Mom is out and about and it is not checking location every 20 minutes as promised.  Tech Support has tried to fix numerous times to no avail.  We will be cancelling our account.    We we're a satisfied customer for over two years.

I noticed a review from March of 2017 complaining of the same thing I am encountering. I try to open the app and it makes me sign in multiple times. Once you sign in it should give you the option to stay signed in. The app needs updated or needs work. If the app isn't working, how do I know if the devise is? My mother is 800 miles away, I have to rely on this devise. I am paying a monthly premium for this service it needs to work properly!

My Dad has been using a Splash for 2 plus years and thankfully has not had to use it in an emergency. He tests it on occasion and a Greatcall rep would be speaking to him immediately.  The app gives me and my other 2 siblings great piece of mind. He lives in a rural area and connectivity has been great and tech support super when we have had any issues. Thank you!!!

Had this app installed when we signed my mother up for the Ultimate plan. Logged in to the app and first screen is a Notice statement. Tapped OK. The app briefly started but then immediately goes back to login page. An endless cycle. So I removed the app thinking it was an older version.  Tried to install new app from Google Play. Takes forever to download and then never installs. Endless download cycle trying to install but never installs. I'm using a Samsung Galaxy S7. Works great on laptop.

Quite a problem lately. It asks me to sign in, then gives me a notice and goes back to sign in. I have reinstalled it, and it still just sends me the notice . Very frustrating as I can't see if my mother has her device with her. This notice screen has got to stop!!!

When we first got this device for my Mom it worked without any issues, lately I can't track her at all. I recently upgraded my phone and reinstalled all of my apps. The app has you signing in multiple times and will disconnect you once signed in. I normally don't complain but this is a good way for us to track her movements are out and about. I'd say since every time an app upgrades it stops it functioning.

The app simply doesn't work sometimes. Other times , at best, it is very slow to tell me my mom has gone out, or returned home. Latest issue - will not let me sign in, and keeps returning to the sign in page, then back to the ad. Even after reloading and setting  a new password. Hardly worth the monthly fee, I can only hope the thing will work from her end.

Continuously have problems when signing in. Many times it won't link to charger, to give battery status. Mom will be wearing device, and I will be told it is still charging. I will be told she is "out and about" when she is at home.

This is the 2nd Greatcall device I have purchased for my 88 year old mother. The Greatcall Lively Wearable was totally useless, this app never connected and the device would disconnect from her cell phone constantly. Now she has the Greatcall Lively, guess what, the app still can't connect to her device! And don't tell me to call or email support, they are also useless. We put in a support ticket on her previous device 6 weeks ago and still haven't been called back.
Last 4 months has only worked about 2 weeks, so my Dad only had a cell phone with no connection to me

App lacking badly. Got this so I could keep up with my dear sweet grandmother, get back to my home state and I can't even sign in. Very disappointing. Now I find out after all the app trouble the actual device has died only after a week. I am furious with this company. Would not recommend it to anyone who needs reliability in a loved ones care.           ZERO STARS
So far, I'm not impressed with Greatcall. My mom has the lively wearable and I downloaded link. Its asking for my sign in info but there is no option to sign up.

Inaccurate, slow to update, no notifications or alerts.  Not a reliable source of info. to coordinate with the Splash device.  Got a new device but the phone app does not work most of the time.  Right now I can't even login to the app.  The tech support always asks me to power down the device and restart so it can make the connection.  I don't live with my mother and she cannot see well enough or comprehend instructions over the phone.  Completely unreliable.

No "create account" function from app; no update on the first day of use; shut-down at log-in day two; and menu options that pertain to primary customer only, not the caregiver or family member.  I am sure there are other issues, but this is only my second day using the app and have already spoken to customer service at least 3 times to no avail.  Was told, as others have stated, that the user needed to reboot the device and I would also need to log out of and back into the app.  This is to be done DAILY.

Works as it should. I don't understand the poor reviews.  For $20 a mo you have a device wherever you go and with a simple push it connects you with help.  I can now leave the house and know my husband has a means for help.  I never purchased this as a gps and for as little as this cost, its crazy you all are complaining about it.  Its meant as a quick means for help not to know exactly where my husband is.

We set up my mother in law with a splash and are very satisfied with it.  The mobile app is very good for tracking one user. Unfortunately, God help you if you have two users with splash.  The app appears to be designed for multiple links; it's NOT.  To make it worse, the tech support prople apparently don't have a clue about this.  They told me to send an invite to the app user. That takes you to the web site, which you can do WITHOUT an invite! Put simply, Greatcall needs to finish the mobile app.

For anyone who might be considering using the Great Call system (Jitterbug) for a friend or family member, I would like to relate my experience. My father-in-law fell last March. My husband spent the better part of six months caring for him. While we were up there last summer, we came across the Jitterbug and thought it would be a perfect fit. Basically, another pair of eyes that could check on Dad remotely and make sure he was OK. Since September when we discovered we could not "see" him, I have spent hours on the phone with Great Call and pretty much gotten nowhere. To make a long story shorter, today when I called to cancel the account, they clearly did not seem to care. There was no effort whatsoever on their part to sway my opinion. Additionally, when I asked for at least a partial refund, after conferencing with a supervisor, I was offered the paltry sum of $15. This isn't even half of what I've paid them for one month and I strongly expressed my displeasure. Their response was this amount was for the "link." Maybe I'm off in left field somewhere, but it would seem to me that if the "link" doesn't work, nothing else matters or works. Clearly false advertising!

If the link worked as well as the emergency call feature this would be perfect but the link portion is awful. I had finished dinner out with my mother when it notified me that she was 'out and about'. About an hour and a half late. Also when she charges her phone it loses the link and will not reconnect until I reboot her phone for her.  She will go days without it linking. Also when I repeatedly reported the issue they just finally stopped responding to me. It seldom gets her location right. Disappointed.

Was great at first. Will give notifications of location on some days, other days it does not.  Is usually back to giving notifications by the time support returns response to email support request.  Instead of location/notifications becoming more accurate over time, they seem to have become less accurate. However, if the app is working and lets me log in, it is generally good about bringing up a location when I use the current location feature.    Also, we seem to be getting a lot more predatory scam calls for my grandmother since we've had this service.  I cannot say for certain that this service is this reason, but the privacy policy does say that they will share your personal info and anyone's that you put in as a contact for the account holder. I assume that most similar services will have comparable privacy policies, though.  Ultimately, I have confidence that should an emergency occur while my grandmother is out walking, the "Splash" device is simple enough that she can use it to get help.
We have accounts for my mom and my mother in law. So far the links are working good. I especially like the battery status alerts....I can immediately call to have them charge up their phones.

We had it set-up last night but it shows that their is a problem accessing the information about her and cannot edit anything unless it is my mother in law gives us access to see anything. Not worth the money spent.

This a great app. It gives us all peace of mind knowing mom has ready access to help. Unlike others that stay in the home we like that she can take this device with her when she is out and about. Thanks for coming up with this great concept.

We got this for my mother and after the first two mo. it won't let us check on her... and her unit keeps shutting off.......my app won't let me access her... I guess the link is down and until they can get it up we will continued problem on accessing and being able to update her soft ware... but when she pushes her button the DO answer immediately... And that is the most important thing.

The subscriber has to send you an invite to make the app work.  It can be confusing with a senior to explain apps and e-mail, but its worth it.  My father in law has freedom and we are able to unobtrusively keep track of him.  It works like a charm and the peace of mind to us is priceless.
After the newest update I can sign in and then the app force closes. Now I can't check in on my mom's device. Not good!
